articles.title: Understanding the organisation
articles.requirement: Determine internal and external issues relevant to purpose and that affect ability to achieve intended outcomes of the ABMS.

articles.title: Needs of interested parties
articles.requirement: Determine relevant interested parties and their relevant requirements related to bribery.

articles.title: Scope of the ABMS
articles.requirement: Determine boundaries and applicability of the ABMS; document and maintain the scope.

articles.title: ABMS requirements
articles.requirement: Establish, implement, maintain, and continually improve the anti-bribery management system.

articles.title: Bribery risk assessment
articles.requirement: Assess bribery risks faced by the organisation, including risk arising from business associates.

articles.title: Leadership and commitment
articles.requirement: Top management demonstrates leadership and commitment with respect to the ABMS.

articles.title: Anti-bribery policy
articles.requirement: Top management establishes, implements, and maintains an anti-bribery policy that prohibits bribery and commits to legal compliance and continual improvement.

articles.title: Governing body oversight
articles.requirement: Where it exists, the governing body has oversight of the ABMS including regular reporting from top management.

articles.title: Top management roles
articles.requirement: Top management assigns responsibility and authority for ABMS implementation and reporting.

articles.title: Compliance function
articles.requirement: A compliance function is established with authority, independence, and resources to oversee the ABMS.

articles.title: Compliance function reporting
articles.requirement: The compliance function reports to the governing body or equivalent at regular intervals.

articles.title: Addressing bribery risks
articles.requirement: Determine and address risks related to bribery that could affect achievement of intended outcomes.

articles.title: Objectives and planning
articles.requirement: Establish anti-bribery objectives at relevant functions and levels; plan how to achieve them.

articles.title: Resources
articles.requirement: Determine and provide resources needed for establishment, implementation, maintenance and improvement of the ABMS.

articles.title: Competence
articles.requirement: Ensure persons doing work affecting anti-bribery performance are competent; retain documented evidence.

articles.title: Awareness and training
articles.requirement: Persons working under the organisation's control are aware of the anti-bribery policy, their contribution, and consequences of non-compliance.

articles.title: Communication
articles.requirement: Determine internal and external communications relevant to the ABMS.

articles.title: Documented information
articles.requirement: Maintain documented information required by the ABMS; retain evidence of operation.

articles.title: Operational planning and control
articles.requirement: Plan, implement, control, and review processes needed to address bribery risks and requirements.

articles.title: Due diligence
articles.requirement: Conduct proportionate due diligence on transactions, projects, activities, and business associates presenting more than a low bribery risk.

articles.title: Financial controls
articles.requirement: Implement financial controls to manage bribery risk, including controls on cash payments, gifts, hospitality, donations, and facilitation payments.

articles.title: Non-financial controls
articles.requirement: Implement non-financial controls including procurement controls, operational controls, and project controls.

articles.title: Implementing anti-bribery controls by controlled organisations
articles.requirement: Where the organisation controls or has significant influence over other organisations, ensure anti-bribery controls are implemented in those organisations.

articles.title: Business associate commitments
articles.requirement: Implement anti-bribery commitments in relations with business associates: contractual obligations, representations, warranties.

articles.title: Gifts, hospitality, donations
articles.requirement: Establish policies and controls on offering, accepting, and managing gifts, hospitality, donations, and similar benefits.

articles.title: Managing inadequacy of anti-bribery controls
articles.requirement: Address situations where anti-bribery controls implemented by a business associate are inadequate.

articles.title: Raising concerns
articles.requirement: Implement accessible and protected channels for raising concerns about bribery; encourage use without fear of retaliation.

articles.title: Investigating and dealing with bribery
articles.requirement: Establish processes for investigating and dealing with actual or alleged bribery when brought to attention.

articles.title: Monitoring, measurement, analysis
articles.requirement: Monitor and measure ABMS performance; analyse and evaluate results; retain documented evidence.

articles.title: Internal audit
articles.requirement: Conduct internal audits at planned intervals to determine whether the ABMS conforms to requirements and is effectively implemented.

articles.title: Management review
articles.requirement: Top management reviews the ABMS at planned intervals to ensure its continuing suitability, adequacy, and effectiveness.

articles.title: Compliance function review
articles.requirement: The compliance function reviews the ABMS and reports to top management.

articles.title: Governing body review
articles.requirement: The governing body reviews the ABMS performance at regular intervals.

articles.title: Nonconformity and corrective action
articles.requirement: React to nonconformity, take action to control and correct, and deal with consequences; eliminate cause of nonconformity.

articles.title: Continual improvement
articles.requirement: Continually improve suitability, adequacy, and effectiveness of the ABMS.

articles.title: Organisational structures
articles.requirement: Structure the organisation to minimise bribery risks through segregation of duties and appropriate oversight.

articles.title: Responsibilities
articles.requirement: Define and communicate anti-bribery responsibilities clearly across functions.

articles.title: Employment process
articles.requirement: Apply appropriate due diligence in recruitment and appointment, particularly for high-risk roles.

articles.title: Raising concerns
articles.requirement: Designate a specific person or function responsible for receiving and reviewing concerns raised.

articles.title: Business associates due diligence
articles.requirement: Conduct risk-based due diligence on business associates; document the process and outcomes.

articles.title: Gifts, hospitality
articles.requirement: Establish written policy on acceptable gifts and hospitality thresholds with pre-approval mechanisms.

articles.title: Managing bribery risks in contracts
articles.requirement: Include anti-bribery representations and termination rights in contracts with business associates.

articles.title: Anti-bribery compliance management
articles.requirement: Ensure the compliance function is staffed with sufficient qualified personnel with appropriate authority.

articles.title: Financial controls
articles.requirement: Implement controls over petty cash, expense reimbursement, and approval thresholds to prevent bribery.

articles.title: Implementing anti-bribery controls
articles.requirement: Ensure anti-bribery controls are embedded in operational processes and subject to regular testing.

articles.title: Anti-bribery management for controlled organisations
articles.requirement: Cascade ABMS requirements to controlled entities proportionate to risk.

articles.title: Investigating and dealing with bribery — roles
articles.requirement: Define investigation roles, timelines, and escalation paths for bribery concerns and incidents.
